note.zh-TW: 「固定資產」是舊稱，照教材顯示並加「舊稱」標記，現行名稱列為別名；課程的門檻只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分（設計說明見 T24）。
note.en: Fixed assets is an older term, shown as the course writes it with an old-name marker; the current name is kept as an alias and the course threshold is shown only as a course reference value and is not scored (see the design note T24).

definition.zh-TW: 權益加非流動負債這些長期資金，相對於不動產、廠房及設備淨額的比率。它檢查長期資產是不是用長期的錢買的；數值越高越穩健，太低表示拿短期的錢去買長期資產。
definition.en: Long-term funding (equity plus non-current liabilities) relative to the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment. It tests whether long-term assets are financed with long-term money; higher is safer, and a low value means short-term money is paying for long-term assets.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
